## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a beginner-friendly Silver layer with basic data quality and observability for a Databricks pipeline.

- Bronze/Silver/Gold layering, schema normalization, watermarking, and basic deduping
- Query-time data quality checks and simple alerting

# Dynamic masking helper for PII protection

    if not value:
        return value
    if field_type == 'email' and '@' in value:
        local, domain = value.split('@', 1)
        return f"{local[0]}***@{domain}"
    elif field_type == 'phone':
        return value[:3] + '***' + value[-4:] if len(value) > 7 else '***'
